The Grand Pavilion — Wedding Banquet & Convention Venue, Hyderabad

The Grand Pavilion is a large convention-style wedding venue in Hyderabad with a
pillarless banquet hall (capacity ~1,500), a pre-function area, and an adjacent
open-air terrace for ceremonies. It is a popular choice for big-fat receptions
and corporate-scale wedding events.

The main hall rents at ₹4,75,000 per day, including basic lighting, air
conditioning, and valet parking. Catering is exclusively in-house; outside
caterers are not permitted, though outside decorators are allowed.

Contact: +91 90000 51277 · banquets@grandpavilion.example
GST: 36AAEGP2210R1Z3
Location: HITEC City, Hyderabad, Telangana
Rating: 4.6 / 5 (209 reviews)

What couples say:
"The pillarless hall gave us a clear view from every seat."
"Massive capacity handled our 1,300 guests with room to spare."
"Valet and parking were well managed even with a full house."

The Grand Pavilion is well-suited to large urban weddings and provides an
on-site event manager and a backup generator. Couples comparing venues often
reference its exact hall rate (₹4,75,000/day) and GST registration when
shortlisting.
